state: finite typed cell vector plus designated graph incidence
event: simultaneous constant overwrite with explicit unary guard observations
selection: one Boolean decision per tag; retaining a tag retains all occurrences
receipts: rebased in the selected execution context
typing: base/final checks plus static event preservation rule; not a full dynamic graph typecheck after every step
one_write_result: polynomial closure and unique maximum valid retention under stated fragment
two_write_result: NP-complete with Boolean cells, <=2 writes/cell, exactly one event/aspect, one forced keep and one forced removal
two_write_nonclaim: events may have polynomial footprint; constant-arity hardness is not proved
